description: This file defines an abstract Controller class in PHP, providing methods for handling HTTP responses, form creation, service management, and event dispatching within the Goteo application framework.

classes.name: Controller
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common web controller functionalities such as rendering responses, managing forms, services, and events within the Goteo framework.

methods.name: viewResponse
methods.description: Renders a view with variables and returns an HTTP response, switching to JSON if 'pronto' parameter is present and conditions are met.

methods.name: rawResponse
methods.description: Returns a plain text or file download response with specified content type and status.

methods.name: jsonResponse
methods.description: Returns a JSON response with optional pretty print in debug mode.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Forwards the request to another controller with specified path and query parameters.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to a specified path or current request URI.

methods.name: contextVars
methods.description: Adds context variables to all views, optionally within a specific view path.

methods.name: getService
methods.description: Retrieves a specific service from the container.

methods.name: dispatch
methods.description: Dispatches an event with an optional event object.

methods.name: createFormBuilder
methods.description: Creates a form builder with default options and current request URI.

methods.name: getModelForm
methods.description: Creates and returns a form processor for a model with validation options.

methods.name: getEntityForm
methods.description: Creates and returns a form processor for an entity with validation options.
